facts: Billionaire High Performance Coach (BHPC) is the flagship mode of A Player Mode, published by Spry Labs: a 47-page PDF manual with nine copy-and-paste prompts.

BHPC sets up the AI chat you already use (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, DeepSeek or any AI chat) as a five-person executive team that plans your day, shrinks the day when you are behind and picks up after a missed day.

The five BHPC roles are Executive Coach, Executive Assistant, Chief of Staff, Accountability Partner and Cognitive Behavioral Mindset Coach, which uses tools inspired by cognitive behavioral methods and is not therapy.
BHPC costs $49 once through a secure Gumroad checkout, with an instant PDF download and no subscription; all sales are final.
Setting BHPC up takes about 20 to 30 minutes, and daily use takes about five minutes.
BHPC is a self-guided, static system: it is not a course and has no live coaching calls or retainer.

Inside BHPC: a daily agenda engine, a morning trigger, Never Miss Twice, Minimum Viable Day, a high-pressure coaching mode, an executive review mode, an arbitration engine for the foreground priority and an end-of-day check-in.

BHPC is not only for founders: it is for operators, creatives, students, athletes, career-switchers, parents and executives in a new seat who want clearer priorities and faster recovery after imperfect days.
Sample pages from the BHPC manual are shown on billionairehighperformancecoach.com before anyone buys.
BHPC is written by S. L. Taylor and published by Spry Labs; the current manual is version 2.2.
If a BHPC download does not open, Spry Labs sends it again when contacted through Gumroad.

The A Player Mode app is the full system that runs the team for you on a monthly plan; its web app and Android download are live today with card checkout, and the iPhone and store apps are coming soon, awaiting store approval.
lacks: BHPC is not medical, psychological, legal, financial, therapeutic or diagnostic advice, and it promises no outcome, income or wealth.
